name: Isaac Rotwang
source:
One of the latest models of androids, Isaac is the result of Maria's attempts to recreate the process used to make her. However, her faulty method caused him to end up as an awkward mixture of creature and machine.

Because even other monsters are weirded out by him, Isaac attempts to fit in by being overly helpful.

[From [url=http://monstrousloversevn.tumblr.com/characters]official site[/url]]
